feature: Card scanning: the detected card's outline, drawn wherever the card is (no fixed guide)
note: Needs network (Scryfall's card image, the detector and embedder, onnxruntime-web), and Chromium's fake camera, which the runner starts per width from `camera` (scripts/lib/fake-camera.mjs). The match endpoint may answer 503 no-index on a database the index has not reached; the outline does not depend on it. Four widths: a card held off-centre and turned (phone-card, desktop-card), and an empty table (phone-empty, desktop-empty), which draws no outline and only the hint. Deliberately no add, no printing step: an add writes a ledger entry to whatever database the app points at.

rows.label: The scanner with a card off-centre: its outline follows the card
The scanner with no card in view: no outline, one line of hint
